Messages.Author: Myrdin
Messages.Body:
Riot Shield, Equipment, 1 pool, U
Melee weapon. Strike: dodge. Or if bearer has Nightstick equipped, strike: dodge with an additional strike only usable with Nightstick. Only usable once each round.

Optionally:
Riot Shield, Equipment, 1 pool, U
Melee weapon. Strike: dodge. Or if bearer has a melee weapon equipped, strike: dodge with an additional strike only usable with melee weapon. Only usable once each round.

Just for fun =)

Ivan - Maybe this?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Myrdin wrote:
> Riot Shield, Equipment, 1 pool, U
> Melee weapon. Strike: dodge. Or if bearer has Nightstick equipped, strike: dodge with an additional strike only usable with Nightstick. Only usable once each round.
>
I like it, but i would tweak it this way:

Riot Shield, Equipment, 0 pool, U
Melee weapon. Strike: prevent all damage from the opposing minion's strike (including any currently-resolving strike), with an additional strike only usable with a Nightstick. Only usable once each round.

Dodge is quite powerful, it should prevent only the opposing minion strike, like Nightstick does.

Not just for fun, I think it's a legitimate idea. I've seen Imbued play Concealed Nightstick for the same reason you would play Riot Shield. With this, they could have an even mix of both for no disadvantage and a very flavorful potential bonus effect.
